title: Vanishing boundary gives the ambient weak-derivative identity ∫_{V∩Q} g·D_{τ_j}f dHⁿ = 0
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, V ⊆ ℝ^P, S ∈ 𝒟_n(V) with ∂S = 0 in V (BoundaryVanishes S), τ = (τ_1, …, τ_n) an orthonormal family in ℝ^P, Q := span{τ_1, …, τ_n}, and g : ℝ^P → ℝ such that S(ω) = ∫_{V∩Q} g(x)·ω(x)(τ_1, …, τ_n) dH^n(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(V) (H^n = μHE[n]). Then for every C^∞ function f : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support and tsupport f ⊆ V, and every index j, ∫_{V∩Q} g(x)·Df(x)(τ_j) dH^n(x) = 0, where Df(x)(v) = fderiv ℝ f x v.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P) (g : Euclid P → ℝ), 1 ≤ n → Orthonormal ℝ τ → BoundaryVanishes S → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, S ω = ∫ x in V ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), g x * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x τ ∂μHE[n]) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ V → ∀ j : Fin n, ∫ x in V ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), g x * fderiv ℝ f x (τ j) ∂μHE[n] = 0
